description: Use when an agent must turn audio into text (meetings, calls, voice notes). Input: POST a file (multipart 'file', raw body, JSON audioBase64) or url; mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm, flac, max 25 MB / 10 min. Output: text, language, timestamped segments, word count, duration; summary=true adds summary, key points, action items. $0.006 per started minute (+$0.004 summary), quoted before payment. Not stored. Example: POST {"url":"https://.../call.mp3"} Price: $0.006–$0.064 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

audioBase64.description: Audio bytes as base64 (alternative to url; max 25 MB decoded)

summary.description: Add summary, key points and action items (+$0.004)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of an audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm, flac; max 25 MB, 10 min)

name: ai_transcribe
title: Speech-to-text: Whisper transcript with timestamps, Korean and English, optional summary
